name: Kavya, the Freelance Designer
tagline: Her own boss: great months, lean months, no safety net.
story: Left the agency to freelance on her own terms in Pune. When clients say yes the money is lovely; when they go quiet it is not. No employer cover, no provident fund, no pension, and nobody else to fall back on but the clients she keeps.

job_loss.name: A big client left
job_loss.story: Your biggest client walked away and the work dried up for {months} months. Your new clients paid {pct}% less.

job_offer.name: A big new client
job_offer.story: A big new client came along and took you on. Your income jumped {pct}%.

provenance.basis: Illustrative: a mid-level independent designer in a large city, mid-2020s. Her yearly billings after costs are the salary. A 9% yearly chance of losing a big client (layoff risk), income that follows the economy fully, no severance and no employer health cover are the point of the persona. Base pay growth of 6.8% a year is nominal (about 2.3 points above the 4.5% inflation average).
